Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 78
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north entrance apron, south entrance apron
- single-story retail row under a continuous overhang building at along the back of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, EIFS stucco panels, flat with continuous overhang roof, 60 feet from road setback
- detached end-cap retail unit building at north end of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, metal fascia panels, flat parapet roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on rear property line pole
- landscape: parking lot islands with curbing, landscape strip along the road frontage, painted stall striping
- immutable elements: continuous storefront overhang along the retail row, pylon sign base at the road frontage, parking lot islands
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. An aging 2005 strip mall — national franchises mixed with struggling locals, the video store on its last legs.

CONDITION: declining — faded paint, minor wear, aging signage, sparse activity

PERIOD DETAILS
- dollar store anchor with yellow 'EVERYTHING $1' signage
- video rental store with 'STORE CLOSING — EVERYTHING MUST GO' banners
- tax preparation office with a green square logo
- a RadioShack store, red sign board with white lettering
- window signs: 'NO CREDIT? NO PROBLEM!', 'RINGTONES $1.99'
- a cart corral in the lot
- a free real-estate flyer box by the walkway
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 2 people TOTAL: 1 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a mom comparing coupons outside the dollar store
- a woman texting on a flip phone under the canopy
- an office worker clipped to a Bluetooth headset mid-conversation
Clothing: men in trucker hats, frosted tips hair; women in trucker hats, velour tracksuits. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 2 period vehicles, all different:
- 2002-2007 Jeep Liberty — round-headlight compact SUV — white
- 2001-2007 Toyota Highlander — early crossover — dark blue
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2005.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first one parked on the LEFT side near the corner; the rest parked on the RIGHT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

DECAY
- faded mansard shingles patched in mismatched colors
- two blank white sign panels where tenants moved out
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: clearly smaller than in the source — about 40% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: clearly smaller than in the source — about 60% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- oak tree at back property line: clearly smaller than in the source — about 80% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
